subject.title: fix: accept valid MCP tool schemas without strict inputSchema.type check

question: Should bundled MCP cataloging depend on the SDK’s private `cacheToolMetadata()` method to retain output-schema and task guards while accepting missing root `inputSchema.type` values?
rationale: The current patch contains a focused runtime pin and behavioral proof, but choosing a private dependency contract versus an upstream/public API is a durable owner-boundary decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Approve the pinned cache seam
options.body: Accept the narrow private call with its existence pin and behavioral regression coverage, then rebase and validate the final head before merge.

options.title: Require a supported SDK path
options.body: Pause this PR until the MCP SDK exposes a public metadata-cache or relaxed-listing contract that can replace the private method.

recommendation.title: Approve the pinned cache seam
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow private call with its existence pin and behavioral regression coverage, then rebase and validate the final head before merge.
